'''2001 I-10 Cup (November)''' was a Star Wars CCG i-10 cup held in Arizona in November 2001. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3493">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-11-at-long-last-hayes-freedomcon-trd3493/ at-long-last-hayes-freedomcon-tr], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 11 March 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-03-11-at-long-last-hayes-freedomcon-trd3493/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' November 2001
* '''Site:''' Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
